headline: Bulgaria Unveils 116 Tourist Trips for Eurovision 2027 in Burgas
summary: Bulgaria is preparing 116 excursions and tourist programmes for Eurovision visitors in Burgas in May 2027. It plans to spend nearly €35 million on tourism promotion and air connections next year.
why: Tourism spending and air connectivity affect hotel, airline and travel demand in host regions. Large events like Eurovision are often used to boost visitor numbers and local economic activity.
